events.summary: The demo has been updated to V0.66. Fixed lingering Eye effects after a clear and delayed enemy effects interrupting a completed shift. Added a saved flash control option. The new mode supports Click to Flash with a mouse, or hold RT to charge and press LT once charged to flash with a controller. Updated the on-screen control hints to match. Jumpscare presentation Adjusted lighting, facial expressions and movement, camera motion, sound effects, and screen effects. events.title: Demo V0.642: Retry Screen Bug Fix
events.summary: The Night Portable demo has been updated to V0.642. Fixed an issue where cracks remained on the handheld screen after retrying. Thank you for reporting this issue.

events.title: Demo V0.64: Make more time for handheld games during your shift
events.summary: The Night Portable demo has been updated to V0.64. Based on gameplay videos and player feedback, this update brings changes to the handheld games, the tutorial, and UI readability. The main idea is simple: play a little, get back to work, then pick up where you left off. These changes are designed to make earning items more manageable while you keep up with your duties and watch your surroundings. events.title: Demo V0.633: Fixed controller scrolling in PC emails
events.summary: Fixed an issue that prevented scrolling through email messages on the PC screen with a controller. With an email open, move the right stick up or down, or use the D-pad, to scroll through the message.

events.title: Demo V0.632: Enemy firing adjustments in the space shooter
events.summary: The Night Portable demo has been updated to V0.632. This update adjusts enemy fire in the space shooter on the Kizupota, preventing enemies from aiming backward at your ship after passing it. Space shooter adjustments Regular enemies and mid-bosses now aim only within a 140-degree forward arc (70 degrees to either side). They will not aim at your ship when it is behind them. events.title: From Complete Beginner to Showcasing “Night Portable” at Events
events.summary: Hello, I’m Kabocha Misoshiru from Pumpkin Miso Studio. I work an office job in Sapporo, Hokkaido, and spend my evenings and days off developing Night Portable, a horror game made with Unity 6, mostly on my own. When I first started making games, I had never used Unity, C#, or Blender. At the end of 2024, I installed Unity and began teaching myself through courses, videos, and documentation.
